### Day 80: 1 Kings 1:11–31
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-80-1-kings-1-1131.html
Passage: 1 Kings 1:11-31
Points:
- Nathan proved to be a genuine prophet by confronting past sin while actively protecting David, Bathsheba, and Solomon.
- Bathsheba approached David to make him aware of the threat to the royal succession.
- David personally called Bathsheba into his presence to swear his oath directly to her as both sovereign and husband.
- Confronted with urgent necessity, the ailing king summoned the strength to execute the will of God.
- Bathsheba responded with humble homage and honored the king for keeping his word.
